Q985.reason: A person entering a commercial store, even to use the bathroom, is treated as a business visitor because entry is connected to the owner's business dealings.

Q966.reason: A landowner who constructs an underground system is liable for subsidence of a neighbor's land only if negligent, so the woman wins unless negligence is proven.

Q899.reason: Agency heads have final responsibility for operating their agencies' offices, so the President cannot unilaterally set office hours.
